description: Mutations for cloud-preset retention and configured fallback after selected-preset removal.

mutants.description: A preset still present in the cloud listing must be retained with its file and setting id; returning true would erase it.

mutants.old: if (!preset.sync_info.empty()) return false; // syncing, not remove
mutants.new: if (preset.sync_info.empty()) return false; // syncing, not remove
mutants.description: A nonempty sync marker retains the syncing preset while an ordinary empty-sync preset is removed; inverting this gate reverses those observable outcomes.

mutants.old: if (preset.setting_id.empty()) return false; // no id, not remove
mutants.new: if (!preset.setting_id.empty()) return false; // no id, not remove
mutants.description: A preset without a setting id is retained, while a deleted cloud preset with an id is removed; inverting the predicate keeps the wrong population.
Removing the selected printer must select the remaining printer with the configured default model; an unmatched model falls back to the wrong preset.
